name: API Key Middleware
description: Per-API-key endpoint allowlist (HTTP method + path) for the Jellyfin API.
overview: Limits what each API key can call, with a point-and-click rule builder.

versions.changelog: Built for Jellyfin 12.4.0; the plugin version now follows the Jellyfin version. Control characters are removed from logged path templates. Docs: security policy, uninstall/rollback, review note for pre-selected endpoints. License: GPL-3.0.
